fusions.name: Whirl by the Handle
fusions.desc: Swings the blade in a full circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fistful of Stalks
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and cuts it for 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Longer in the Arm
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Hands That Learned It

riders.text: your hands make the stroke before you have thought of it
and you swing clear of what comes back
and you cover the ground between on all fours

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you attack 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you move 5% faster.
